answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one marble weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 96 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 48 times the capital for one share. The crystal report exposes the merge explicitly at each vine. A farm of 4106 identities would post 1658 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
